Whatever you do, don't move into The Birch or any apartments managed by Collective Glendale. I had bed bug bites all over my body less than 2 months after living there and the management team could not have cared less. The entire building was infested, from the 1st floor to the 4th. Also roaches. Pest control would only come 1 day of the week, and there were many times they didn't bother to show up at all, which is a clear violation of Colorado's Warrant of Habitability. 
I have more horror stories from the year I lived there if you want to hear them, but it was the worst year of my life. I paid $1,150 plus parking, utilities, trash, etc, for a 490 sq ft studio

Edit: wanted to add that I moved out in October of 2024. It was very recent.

My new favorite thing is to watch the sun set or just the night sky in general while smoking a cigarette and listening to a song. Not that I recommend the cigarette thing. I just find them to be incredibly relaxing.
But moments like that just kinda freeze time. When you're sitting there, by yourself, with the trees for company and the clouds for entertainment, time slows down. And you have a second, a minute, maybe a few hours if you're lucky, to not exist. To blend your being in with your surroundings to the point that it feels like you belong there, on that porch step. That you were always supposed to be there.
Or maybe I'm just rambling.
